title: Terp Standard - the refused raw frontend surface
description: The normative declaration of the raw browser primitives an app module must not author directly. The prohibition is the portable part of the rules that cite this file (token-styled-elements, no-inline-styling, generated-client-only, no-style-imports, no-deep-imports); which sanctioned component or helper answers each primitive is per-stack configuration, recorded non-normatively in the catalog entry's 'reference' field. A checker realises this file for its language; the reference adapter's BOUNDARY_SPEC is parity-tested against it.
